About Kerissa Rivas

Service, preparation and a responsibility to explain things clearly.

Kerissa’s work is centered on helping people understand important financial decisions before uncertainty becomes urgency.

Her approach

Financial guidance should begin with understanding the person.

Kerissa’s professional path has been shaped by military service, financial experience and leadership. Across each of those settings, preparation and accountability mattered. Those same principles shape how she works with clients today.

She created KB & Associates Wealth Group to offer a more personal experience: one where clients have time to ask questions, understand the purpose behind a strategy and consider how each decision affects their families and future.

The objective is not to make financial planning sound complicated. It is to make the important issues easier to recognize and discuss.

What clients can expect

A professional conversation without the cold corporate experience.

  • Questions before recommendations
  • Clear explanations instead of jargon
  • Respect for individual circumstances
  • Attention to family and business responsibilities
  • Ongoing review as priorities change

Principles

What guides the work.

These principles should shape every client and team interaction.

01

Education

Clients should understand the issue and available direction before making a decision.

02

Preparation

Important conversations are easier when they happen before a crisis creates urgency.

03

Responsibility

Recommendations must reflect the real people and obligations connected to each decision.

04

Relationship

A client’s needs may change, so communication should continue beyond the first meeting.
